record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, Altaschith<WH0516><WTH8686>, Michtam<WH04387> of David<WH01732>; when Saul<WH07586> sent<WH07971><WTH8800>, and they watched<WH08104><WTH8799> the house<WH01004> to kill him<WH04191><WTH8687>.<Fo><Fo> Deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me from mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, O my God<WH0430>: defend<WH07682><WTH8762> me from them that rise up<WH06965><WTH8693> against me. <RF>Altaschith...: or, Destroy not<Rf> <RF>Michtam: or, A golden Psalm<Rf> <RF>defend...: Heb. set me on high<Rf>
Deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me from the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205>, and save<WH03467><WTH8685> me from bloody<WH01818> men<WH0582>.

For, lo, they lie in wait<WH0693><WTH8804> for my soul<WH05315>: the mighty<WH05794> are gathered<WH01481><WTH8799> against me; not <FI>for<Fi> my transgression<WH06588>, nor <FI>for<Fi> my sin<WH02403>, O LORD<WH03068>.

They run<WH07323><WTH8799> and prepare<WH03559><WTH8709> themselves without <FI>my<Fi> fault<WH05771>: awake<WH05782><WTH8798> to help<WH07125><WTH8800> me, and behold<WH07200><WTH8798>. <RF>help: Heb. meet<Rf>

Thou therefore, O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, awake<WH06974><WTH8685> to visit<WH06485><WTH8800> all the heathen<WH01471>: be not merciful<WH02603><WTH8799> to any wicked<WH0205> transgressors<WH0898><WTH8802>. Selah<WH05542>.
They return<WH07725><WTH8799> at evening<WH06153>: they make a noise<WH01993><WTH8799> like a dog<WH03611>, and go round about<WH05437><WTH8779> the city<WH05892>.
Behold, they belch out<WH05042><WTH8686> with their mouth<WH06310>: swords<WH02719> <FI>are<Fi> in their lips<WH08193>: for who, <FI>say they<Fi> , doth hear<WH08085><WTH8802>?<CM>
But thou, O LORD<WH03068>, shalt laugh<WH07832><WTH8799> at them; thou shalt have all the heathen<WH01471> in derision<WH03932><WTH8799>.
<FI> Because of<Fi> his strength<WH05797> will I wait<WH08104><WTH8799> upon thee: for God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> my defence<WH04869>. <RF>defence: Heb. high place<Rf>

The God<WH0430> of my mercy<WH02617> shall prevent<WH06923><WTH8762> me: God<WH0430> shall let me see<WH07200><WTH8686> <FI>my desire<Fi> upon mine enemies<WH08324><WTH8802>. <RF>enemies: Heb. observers<Rf>

Slay<WH02026><WTH8799> them not, lest my people<WH05971> forget<WH07911><WTH8799>: scatter<WH05128><WTH8685> them by thy power<WH02428>; and bring them down<WH03381><WTH8685>, O Lord<WH0136> our shield<WH04043>.

<FI> For<Fi> the sin<WH02403> of their mouth<WH06310> <FI>and<Fi> the words<WH01697> of their lips<WH08193> let them even be taken<WH03920><WTH8735> in their pride<WH01347>: and for cursing<WH0423> and lying<WH03585> <FI>which<Fi> they speak<WH05608><WTH8762>.

Consume<WH03615><WTH8761> <FI>them<Fi> in wrath<WH02534>, consume<WH03615><WTH8761> <FI>them<Fi> , that they <FI>may<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> : and let them know<WH03045><WTH8799> that God<WH0430> ruleth<WH04910><WTH8802> in Jacob<WH03290> unto the ends<WH0657> of the earth<WH0776>. Selah<WH05542>.
And at evening<WH06153> let them return<WH07725><WTH8799>; <FI>and<Fi> let them make a noise<WH01993><WTH8799> like a dog<WH03611>, and go round about<WH05437><WTH8779> the city<WH05892>.

Let them wander up and down<WH05128><WTH8686><WTH8675><WH05128><WTH8799> for meat<WH0398><WTH8800>, and grudge<WH03885><WTH8799> if they be not satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799>. <RF>for meat: Heb. to eat<Rf> <RF>and grudge...: or, if they be not satisfied, then they will stay all night<Rf>

But I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799> of thy power<WH05797>; yea, I will sing aloud<WH07442><WTH8762> of thy mercy<WH02617> in the morning<WH01242>: for thou hast been my defence<WH04869> and refuge<WH04498> in the day<WH03117> of my trouble<WH06862>.
Unto thee, O my strength<WH05797>, will I sing<WH02167><WTH8762>: for God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> my defence<WH04869>, <FI>and<Fi> the God<WH0430> of my mercy<WH02617>.<CM>
